title: Weeknight Chicken Satay
description: A quick and easy Malaysian-inspired dish, perfect for a busy weeknight. Grilled chicken skewers served with a side of peanut sauce.
instructions: 1. In a blender or food processor, combine coconut milk, peanut butter, soy sauce, honey, brown sugar, ginger, and garlic. Blend until smooth.
2. Add the chicken to a large bowl and pour the peanut sauce over it. Toss to coat.
3. Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers.
4. Heat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat. Brush with vegetable oil.
5. Grill the chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
6. Meanwhile, heat the peanut sauce in a small saucepan over low heat.
7. Serve the grilled chicken with the peanut sauce on the side and garnished with peanuts.
